blocks.text: This Halloween season, Discovery Boracay and Discovery Coron transform into haunted hideaways for ‘Dolls After Dark’, adding a touch of thrilling mystery to their annual trick-or-treat traditions on the islands. Happening on October 31, 2026, kids and families are invited to an afternoon filled with playful frights and exciting activities. The Biggest Halloween Dollhouse Event on Boracay Island Discovery Boracay transforms into Hollow Manor, a Victorian-era dollhouse, opening its doors to both in-house and walk-in guests. Children are invited to take part in this curious world to play, dance, and share sweet treats with its peculiar living doll hosts. Participation is […]...
